title: Worlds Edge Map Platform
description: A surreal painted scene depicts a stone platform overlooking a vast landscape, featuring a giant map rug with four small explorers standing on it. To the left stands a ruined stone tower with a compass door, while hanging map tapestries and a large compass float in the sky above a winding river and distant mountains.
prompt: Whimsical painted fantasy scene of a stone platform at the edge of the world, giant colorful world map laid on the floor with four tiny adventurers standing on different continents, ancient ruined tower with a compass embedded in its door on the left, multiple illustrated map banners and a large ornate compass hanging from the sky, winding river valley and purple mountains in the background, warm sunset sky with soft clouds, adventurous and surreal atmosphere, detailed illustration style
